body.name: Finite capped confidence modulus and water-filling certificate
body.construction: \(\omega_\alpha(w,q)=\max\{\sum_{l=1}^Lw_l\delta_l:0\le\delta_l\le1\ \forall l,\ \sum_{l=1}^Lq_l\delta_l^2\le x_\alpha\}\). If \(x_\alpha\ge\sum_lq_l\), set \(\delta_l^*=1\) for every \(l\). Otherwise choose the unique \(\lambda_\alpha>0\) solving \(\sum_lq_l\min\{1,\lambda_\alpha w_l/q_l\}^2=x_\alpha\), and set \(\delta_l^*=\min\{1,\lambda_\alpha w_l/q_l\}\). Sorting the breakpoints \(q_l/w_l\) and solving the displayed scalar equation on each adjacent interval is the finite water-filling algorithm.
